name: Minakami Mayu
source:
Student council treasurer.

Due to family discord, she grew up constantly watching her parents' expressions, and tends to be timid and shy around others.

As a result, she can easily fall in love with someone who is even slightly kind to her...

[Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/game_character.php?game=9978]erogamescape[/url]]
